FF7 FIC RECS
a hug a day keeps the crisis away by digitalcactus
  • AGS, sephiroth-centric. 3 chapters, 13k words. crisis core era, fluffy and humorous.
a political act 🔞 by higharollakockamamie
  • barret/cloud. 4k words. some of my favorite clarret characterization; i could practically hear their voices as i read.
a solitude of space 🔞 by aceofbasedesires
  • sephiroth/cloud, sephiroth-centric. 90k words. post-canon, stardew valley setting, crack treated seriously. unironically some of the best sefikura characterization i've read to date.
between each rib, an open door by skadii
  • zack/cloud. 11k words. an absolutely heartwrenching read with heavy themes of grief. writing inspiration.
closing time 🔞 by surveycorpsjean
  • zack/cloud. 9 chapters, 49k words. modern au/coffee shop au. enemies(ish) to friends to lovers.
dizzy & shouting into the newly unfamiliar absence of morning by feather_cadence
  • no ships, cloud-centric. 6k words. my favorite post-advent children fic, and perhaps my favorite cloud-centric fic of all time. it's quite heavy, but it's such a wonderful read, and i highly recommend it. writing inspiration.
downtime (series) 🔞 by deadly bride
  • barret/cloud. 3 fics, 18k words total. my favorite set of clarret fics.
go the fuck to sleep by digitalcactus
  • no ships. 4k words. a humorous fix-it, and one of my favorite general ff7 fics. zack and cloud prevent the nibelheim incident with one (1) sleep materia.
greyscale 🔞 by angelicsentinel
  • zack/cloud. 14k words. aphrodisiac/fuck or die, zack (and aerith) live au.
laimaudra by creamoftomatosoup
  • no ships, cloud-centric. 4k words. daemon au. very well written. i'm a sucker for daemon aus despite not having read his dark materials; so much can be done with the concept.
rectify 🔞 by unknownlifeform
  • sephiroth/cloud. 68 chapters, 260k words. gods & goddesses au, enemies to lovers, slow burn.
restart by boomchick
  • sephiroth & cloud. 16 chapters, 85k words at the time i'm writing this. i've made it a general rule to only rec finished fics in this list, but i'm making an exception for this one because it's my favorite time travel/time loop fic of all time. please give this a read if time loops pique your interest.
the best laid plans by loralei_dawson
  • no ships, cloud-centric. non-traditional time travel fix-it. cloud retains his memories, but not his mental maturity. holy shit i love this fic.
the fifth act by sinnatious
  • no ships, cloud-centric. non-traditional time travel fix-it. cloud is a man on a mission. this fic is a classic.
